question: Do constructive six-site NAND DAG witnesses resolve the11 observation signatures left unresolved by WSP21's expression-tree compiler?
hypothesis: All11 targets have independently verified witnesses in the exact six-site numerical architecture. Test connected-input DAGs and canonical disconnected-input DAGs separately so sharing is not confused with access to a constant-zero afferent. Failure to find a witness within the frozen budget is UNRESOLVED, never a false unsatisfiability claim.

frozen_design.target_origin: Exactly the11 WSP21 signatures having selected expression cost>6 at the qualified parent; no post-result additions or removals.
frozen_design.capacity: 3 raw input bits,<=6 feedforward NAND sites,75 binary one-hot-or-empty incoming/output row scalars as unchanged WSP15/WSP20. Output must connect to a raw input or gate; it cannot connect directly to the disconnected zero source.
frozen_design.search: Deterministic breadth-first enumeration of sets of available six-observation response vectors. Add NAND of each unordered source pair. Previously generated gates may be reused, so this is DAG search. Deduplicate equivalent available response sets; record a valid target-output witness BEFORE pruning a duplicate/null-valued output. Semantic merging is valid for the six exposed observations only, not hidden truth.
frozen_design.connected: Initial sources only the three raw inputs. Every used incoming row has exactly one nonzero entry; no constant-zero afferent.
frozen_design.allow_disconnected: Also allow an all-zero incoming row as the numerical model already permits. This is source -1 for input only, never an output address. No increase in sites or scalar count.
frozen_design.budget: Per arm maximum500000 unique states and10000000 attempted unordered-pair transitions, depth<=6. Stop after all11 targets have witnesses. Deterministic ascending states/source-values/pairs, no RNG. No budget increases or post-result solver changes. If a cap is hit, report unresolved targets. No UNSAT claim without a separately checked proof.
frozen_design.verification: Each witness is checked independently through generic numeric WSP15 dot/threshold execution, an independent boolean graph interpreter across all8 contexts, canonical75-scalar checkpoint restore, and a checker of depth/forward-only addresses and strict-versus-disconnected semantics.11 SAT witnesses plus unchanged WSP21's53 certificates cover the full64-signature domain if all succeed.
frozen_design.controls: Return exactly the11 original unresolved identities. Reject >6sites, forward/cyclic addresses, illegal output -1, nonbinary evidence, disallowed disconnected rows and corrupted checkpoints. Compare merged search against independent brute wiring enumeration at depth<=2 to audit sharing/deduplication/null-output handling. All256 worlds must remain256/512 on the two hidden labels for any complete evidence-only predictor.
frozen_design.scientific_limits: External exact oracle, not native neural discovery or improved learning. Do not train the numerical learner on oracle answers or change WSP15/16/20 baselines. No claim that every full three-input truth function fits6 sites. Hidden truth remains ambiguous. No stronger superiority claim from the capacity result.
